fields.statement: At 85470cb5, ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(...)$' over the 120 testscripts that call rhiza run start or rhiza request, plus root-* and project-* (including the new runs-need-root.txtar): ok in 435.8s. The new script runs rhiza request and rhiza run start --workflow plan in an unregistered repo under the Setup root (next: rhiza project add <dir>) and in $NOROOT (next: rhiza root init); both fail, and rhiza render and rhiza check then succeed in each. Checked the exit code by hand with a scratch build: in a root with an unregistered repo, and in a folder under no root, rhiza request, rhiza request --json and rhiza run start each exit 2 with code usage and the matching next. In both places rhiza check passes after rhiza render. Read the diff: requireProject in internal/api/root.go guards only runRequest and runRunStart, so model commands are untouched. Setup writes $WORK/rhiza.toml registering repo and sets $NOROOT. The changed scripts register their extra project folders.
